open_items: The read MIT/CMU GLM lecture units do not cover deviance residuals or a generic goodness-of-fit reference law. Add and fully read an authoritative diagnostics unit, or narrow SME-03; do not infer a saturated-model chi-square law from fixed-dimensional Wilks.
The eventual Wishart/Hotelling item must prove its inverse-Wishart quadratic-form step with exact n>p and denominator hypotheses; the independent scribed note defers this proof.
PCA deterministic optimization is sourced; a finite-sample eigenvector confidence law is not proposed. Any explicit stability bound needs a separate checked supplier.
next: No further models-01 source research remains. The models scaffold should resolve the GLM deviance-residual source gap or narrow SME-03; keep Hotelling/Wishart and PCA theorem proof obligations explicit.
